m: Marinade: half the yoghurt with cumin, smoked paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, half the garlic, the juice of half the lemons, a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken and leave at least 20 minutes.
Pink onions: slice the red onion thin, cover with the vinegar, sugar, a pinch of salt and a splash of hot water. Leave 15 minutes.
Garlic yoghurt: the rest of the yoghurt with the remaining garlic (finely grated), a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan, grill or BBQ for 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Salad: chop the tomatoes, cucumber and parsley, dress with lemon, oil and salt.
Warm the wraps in a dry pan. Everyone builds their own: wrap, chicken, salad, onions and plenty of garlic yoghurt.
l: Skip the wrap and make it a bowl: chicken over salad, with the yoghurt in a little container. Add leftover rice if you have it.
g: GF wraps, warmed in a separate pan. Everything else is naturally gluten free.
